claims: The Saturday Night Live Five-Timers Club is a group of hosts who have hosted Saturday Night Live at least five times.
Saturday Night Live Five-Timers Club members are traditionally celebrated with a smoking jacket.
The Saturday Night Live Five-Timers Club was established on-screen in 1990 by Tom Hanks.
Buck Henry was the first to host Saturday Night Live five times.
Alec Baldwin holds the record with 17 hosting appearances on Saturday Night Live.
Steve Martin has 16 hosting appearances on Saturday Night Live.
Candice Bergen is the first female member of the Saturday Night Live Five-Timers Club.
Tom Hanks is a member of the Saturday Night Live Five-Timers Club.
Tina Fey is a member of the Saturday Night Live Five-Timers Club.
Scarlett Johansson is a member of the Saturday Night Live Five-Timers Club.
John Goodman is a member of the Saturday Night Live Five-Timers Club.
Drew Barrymore is a member of the Saturday Night Live Five-Timers Club.
Melissa McCarthy is a member of the Saturday Night Live Five-Timers Club.
Will Ferrell is a member of the Saturday Night Live Five-Timers Club.
Paul Rudd is a member of the Saturday Night Live Five-Timers Club.
Ben Affleck is a member of the Saturday Night Live Five-Timers Club.
John Mulaney is a member of the Saturday Night Live Five-Timers Club.
John Mulaney became a member of the Saturday Night Live Five-Timers Club in 2022.
Emma Stone was inducted into the Saturday Night Live Five-Timers Club.
Jack Black joined the Saturday Night Live Five-Timers Club in April 2026, as noted in the Today.com video.
Saturday Night Live Five-Timers Club monologues feature members showing their IDs.
Saturday Night Live Five-Timers Club monologues feature members wearing smoking jackets.
Saturday Night Live Five-Timers Club monologues feature members interacting in a luxurious secret lounge.
